tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of e Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
All Conditions as per the Bid Document & Other attached documents
Corrigendum/ modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
Acceptance / Cancellation of the TPIA Services are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.
To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered.
Incomplete / conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number

The Agency should have a minimum Total Financial Turnover 5 Crores in the last five years , Consolidated financial turnover certificate certified by Chartered Accountant shall be submitted, along with compulsory UDIN Id No.

The agency/institution should have a minimum of 5 years of experience of undertaking inspection of project works relating to water supply and/or civil infrastructure and should have monitored at least two projects and For TPIA firm, work done certificates issued by the employer not below the rank of Executive Engineer or Equivalent Cadre person shall be submitted mandatorily.

Qualifications and Competence of the key professional staff for the assignment. And The firm / agency should have multi-disciplinary engineering human resource in the field of civil /mechanical / electrical and environment
Adequacy of the Proposed Work plan and Methodology in responding to the TOR
Experience in providing TPIA& auditing services in Karnataka
